PrayerPage.title: Share a prayer request
PrayerPage.intro: Tell us what you would like prayer for. Your request is private, and you can send it without your name.

asidePoints.private: Your request is private. Only the ministry's small admin team can read it.
asidePoints.anonymous: You can send it anonymously. Then we don't keep a name or email address.
asidePoints.consent: Nothing is shown publicly unless you tick the sharing box, and even then only a shortened version without personal details.

PrayerPage.wallTitle: Prayers and testimonies shared with permission
PrayerPage.wallIntro: Shortened versions, with personal details removed, of requests and testimonies whose senders agreed to share them.

PrayerForm.anonymousHint: Your name and email are cleared and not sent. We won't be able to reply.
PrayerForm.emailHint: Only if you would like a reply.
PrayerForm.consentLabel: You may share a shortened version of my request publicly, without my name or contact details.
PrayerForm.consentHint: Optional. Leave unticked to keep your request private.
PrayerForm.privacyNotice: We use your request only to pray for you and, if you asked, to reply. Read our <link>privacy policy</link>.
PrayerForm.successBody: Your request was received and is kept private.

SupportPage.title: Support the Mission
SupportPage.intro: Your prayers and gifts help this ministry share the hope of the Gospel. Thank you for thinking of us.
SupportPage.demoGivingInfo: Sample text: the ministry will describe here how gifts are used.
SupportPage.englishOnly: This section is shown in English until a Nepali version is added.
SupportPage.notConfiguredTitle: Online giving is not set up yet
SupportPage.notConfiguredBody: Thank you for wanting to give. Online giving will open on this page later. Until then, please get in touch and we will gladly tell you about other ways to help.
SupportPage.closedTitle: Online giving is not open right now
SupportPage.closedBody: Online giving is paused for now. Please get in touch if you would like to give or to help in another way.
SupportPage.processorNote: Payments are processed securely by Stripe.
SupportPage.usdNote: All gifts are in US dollars (USD).
SupportPage.noCardNote: We never see or store your card details.
SupportPage.refundNote: Questions about a gift, or need a refund? Email <link>{email}</link>.
SupportPage.manageMonthlyLink: Manage or cancel a monthly gift on Stripe
SupportPage.manageMonthlyEmail: To change or cancel a monthly gift, email <link>{email}</link>.
SupportPage.privacyLink: Read how we handle donation data in our <link>Privacy Policy</link>.
SupportPage.offlineTitle: Give by Zelle or bank transfer
SupportPage.offlineIntro: You can also give straight from your bank account. These gifts go directly to the ministry.
SupportPage.zelleQrCaption: Scan this code with your bank app.
SupportPage.zelleStep1: Open your bank app and choose Zelle.
SupportPage.zelleStep2: Scan the QR code, or enter the email or phone number above.
SupportPage.zelleStep3: Check that the name shows exactly "{name}" before you send.
SupportPage.zelleSafetyBody: We will never ask you to send money to a different name, email or phone number. If anything looks different, don't send it and contact us first.
SupportPage.offlineDirectNote: Zelle and bank transfers are sent directly between banks and can't be reversed.
SupportPage.offlineNotProcessedNote: They aren't processed by this website.
SupportPage.offlineReceiptNote: No receipt is sent automatically. Email <link>{email}</link> if you would like one.
SupportPage.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Please select the text instead.

DonationForm.monthlyHint: Charged once a month until you cancel.
DonationForm.submitMonthly: Continue to set up monthly gift
DonationForm.finishOnStripe: You will finish on Stripe's secure payment page.

SupportThanks.title: Thank you for your gift
SupportThanks.body: Your support means a great deal. Stripe will email your receipt.

SupportCancelled.title: No payment was made
SupportCancelled.body: You left the payment page before finishing, so nothing was charged. You can try again whenever you like.
